title: Thank you so much Me+ !! 😊😊
body: Ever since summer 2023, i’ve had depression. Like, severe depression. I knew about the app from a friend but never got it. Recently, my depression has been getting worse cause of my school work and my family issues. So, I decided to get it. Best decision of my life. Ever since I hot it and used it my life has been more sorted and stable. My mental health was getting better and with a schedule I feel so organised! Me+ doesn’t ring you 24/7 which is amazing cause apps who do that stress me with my schedule. Me+ instead gives you less notifications but still doesn’t let it be forgotten! In my opinion, I use a widget on my lock screen and directly open the app which is super easy! Me+ basically turned my life upside down in a good way! Amazing app, recommend it to everyone! 💖💖 and join their discord server and follow any of their social media profiles! 💝💝
